brief:
Tens of thousands of Palestinians performed Friday prayers at Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem despite restrictions imposed by Israeli occupation forces on worshippers entering the city, Shehab Wire reported. The Jerusalem Islamic Waqf Department said the turnout reached tens of thousands of attendees.

Israeli authorities have maintained security measures limiting access to Jerusalem for Palestinians seeking to pray at the mosque during weekly Friday services.

title: Tens of thousands pray Friday at Al-Aqsa despite Israeli restrictions
